title: World Highways & Road Networks
description: Highway naming conventions and interstate systems inspired by Super-Duper quiz.

questions.prompt: In the United States Interstate Highway System, odd-numbered interstates (like I-5 or I-95) run in which direction?
questions.hint: I-5 runs from Canada to Mexico along the West Coast

questions.prompt: In France, what letter designates the national controlled-access motorway (Autoroute) network?
questions.hint: e.g., A1 Paris-Lille, A6 Autoroute du Soleil

questions.prompt: In Germany, what is the term for the federal controlled-access expressway network famously known for sections without general speed limits?
questions.hint: Signposted with blue signs and an A prefix

questions.prompt: In the United Kingdom, what prefix letter designates the primary motorway system?
questions.hint: e.g., M1, M25 London orbital

questions.prompt: In Spain, what letter prefix designates the state-managed toll motorways (Autopistas)?
questions.hint: e.g., AP-7 Autopista del Mediterráneo

questions.prompt: What is the longest continuous motorable highway system in the world, stretching from Alaska to Argentina?
questions.hint: Spanning nearly 30,000 km, interrupted only by the Darién Gap
